name: watchlist_plain_words_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: WATCHLIST_PLAIN_WORDS_20261104 — FQ-075: watchlist rows state their state in plain words "No provider or model assigned · no external call · no cost yet", "not scheduled" instead of screaming policy/scheduling codes; an unknown reason code is shown de-coded (lower-case words), never raw. Nothing is removed. The registered pytest file RUNS apps/command-center-v3/src/lib/watchlistPlainWords.view.test.mjs, which server-renders the real component and asserts the printed words — not the source text (codex P2605-R1: the source-text version stayed green when the decoder call or the unknown fallback was removed). RED under both mutations, GREEN on the committed component.
